configure prompt recipes (stage, taboos, slots) in the settings GUI
migrate a SQLite knowledge-points database into vault notes
write output notes with frontmatter snapshots and wiki-links to every source note

extras: Bilingual README (English and Chinese); the three built-in seed recipes and default output paths are Chinese-oriented; install currently manual with marketplace approval pending.
motivation: The author frames it with Lippmann's pseudo-environment concept: media pre-process information, and running notes through similar 'mimicry' processing deepens memory of the original material.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to transform stored knowledge notes into memorable narrative forms through AI-driven, user-defined rewriting recipes.
